Grace hopes to visit Toronto one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the post office by bike. The post office is one of the best places in the city. Best of all, the team rescues lost hikers in these mountains.
The weather was sunny that day. Life is full of small surprises. Grace wants to be a driver in the future. Also, the walls are white.
They took many photos at the bank counter. Grace drinks water after doing sports. Tom's birthday is in July. The food here is great.
Tom is interested in drawing. Both of them like fish and water. Grace thinks art is interesting but a little difficult.
